panels.description: Full-page distant elevated view of the 2043 mountain basin, composed vertically so Oasis, Halyard and Keel read immediately. Oasis occupies the upper cloud-bright tier with pearl-white architecture, broad reservoirs, fountains, gardens, quiet automated transit and a distant spacecraft carrying the space-and-mining insignia. Halyard occupies the middle slope with bronze-and-gold fabrication towers, greenhouse terraces, elevated rail, cargo movement, engineered green and three restrained sector insignias. Keel fills the bottom around an exhausted open-pit lithium mine with dense stacked housing, rusted structures, patched pumps, aging factories, dusty lanes, narrow water channels, workers with jugs at a metered tap, checkpoints and a sealed hazard-striped mine entrance. One vertical spine connects all tiers with a huge water conduit, power lines, rail and repeated white-and-amber Alpha nodes. Keep three separate negative-space pockets beside the cities: upper-left for the year caption, upper-right for the Oasis label and question; middle-left for the Halyard label and question below it; bottom-left for the Keel label and bottom-right for its question. Do not place lettering over city details.

items.text: What if everyone you've trusted has a secret?
Who really owns what we create?
Where does all our water go?
